leaveGameConfirm: Are you sure you want to leave the game?

gameOption.baseDescription: STANDARD uses cells 2–12 per row. LONGO uses cells 2–16 with bonus numbers.
gameOption.gameModeDescription: Offline lets players play around a table with real dice.
gameOption.cardModeDescription: Some options always generate unique sheets.
gameOption.bigPointsDescription: Add two bonus rows. You can cross a cell ONLY when you already have a cross above or below it. A cross in these rows counts for both colored rows. The maximum number of crosses is limited to the amount of cells in a row.
gameOption.randomOrderDescription: Shuffle the numbers within each row.
gameOption.extraRowDescription: Add a bonus row that forms a wave across the four rows.
gameOption.connectedCellsDescription: Links cells between rows: crossing one cell automatically crosses the other cell too.
gameOption.connectedDiagonalDescription: One-way diagonal links: crossing a cell also crosses the cell diagonally below it.
gameOption.seeOtherCardsDescription: Shows a miniature of the other players' progress.
gameOption.doubleADescription: Every colored cell gains a smaller twin cell below it in the same row. You may cross the twin once the cell above it is crossed and nothing to its right is crossed yet — an extra cross for the same number.
gameOption.doubleBDescription: Some cells show their number twice on a diagonal and can be crossed twice. The second cross is allowed once the first is made and nothing to its right is crossed yet — an extra cross for the same number.
gameOption.bonusADescription: 12 bonus boxes (gold ring) sit in the coloured rows. Crossing one forces you to cross the next cell of the bonus bar below; its colour forces a cross in that row's next box — which can chain. When a row locks, its remaining bonus-bar cells are forfeited.
gameOption.bonusBDescription: 10 bonus boxes (2 each of 5 kinds) sit in the coloured rows. Cross both of a kind to trigger its bonus, marked on the strip below: ✕✕ two crosses in your fewest-crossed row, ✕ one in every colour, ×2 double that row's score, +13 points, or your mis-rolls don't count.
gameOption.xchangeDescription: Adds an extra row with the option to change your white+white combination for the other number in that cell.
gameOption.botCountDescription: Number of computer-controlled players to add.
gameOption.botStrategyDescription: Playing style for all computer opponents.
gameOption.luckyNumberDescription: Adds a bonus row with 4 bonus points (5, 6, 7, 8). Only the active player can cross this when white die 1 + white die 2 + any colored die equals 15. He can only cross this bonus OR do his regular moves.
gameOption.luckyCrossDescription: Adds 3 bonus cross fields to each colored row (4 for Longo). When any two dice show a 1 and a 5, every player may cross the next available bonus field once. White+white: free choice of row. White+colored: that colored row. Colored+colored: either of those two rows. Can be used before or after the regular move.

endOfGame.heading: End of game
endOfGame.p2: The player with the highest score wins.

turns.heading: How turns work
turns.li1: The dice roller may cross a white+white sum cell, a white+color sum cell, or both — but the white+white cell must always be crossed first.
turns.li2: All other players may only cross a white+white sum cell.
turns.p3: After each roll, every player must confirm their choice — either crossing a number or skipping the round. No one can stay silent. If you skip the round when it is your turn to roll, you take a punishment.

closing.heading: Closing a row
closing.p1: You can close a row by crossing the last cell — but only if you already have at least 5 crosses in that row (or 6 in Longo mode).
closing.longoTip: Longo: a row can also be closed at the second-to-last cell. At that cell you can choose whether to close or not.

lockCross.heading: The lock cross (important!)
lockCross.p1: When you close a row, a cross appears on the lock icon at the end of that row. That cross on the lock counts as one extra cross in your final score.
lockCross.example: Your first cross is worth 1 point, your 10th cross is worth 10 points!

punishments.heading: Punishments
punishments.p1: You receive a punishment when you skip the round as the dice roller. Each punishment costs 5 points from your final score. Four punishments ends the game immediately.

rowClosure.confirmQuestion: Do you want to change your last selection?
rowClosure.selfClose: Do you want to close this row?

bonusB.doubleFewest: ×2 the score of your fewest-crossed row
bonusB.plus13: +13 points at the end of the game
bonusB.noPenalty: mis-rolls don't count as minus points
